# Reuben Oluwafemi

> WordPress Plugin & Frontend Developer building custom WordPress plugins and production React and Vue.js interfaces, plus the API integrations and performance work around them. Also known as Reuben Tomoloju.

## About

Reuben Oluwafemi (also published as Reuben Tomoloju on WordPress.org, LinkedIn and GitHub) is a WordPress plugin and frontend developer. He designs and engineers the parts of a product that have to hold up under real traffic: custom WordPress and WooCommerce plugins, React and Vue.js interfaces, the integrations between them, and the performance work that keeps it all fast. Clients work directly with him, with no hand-offs.

- [About](https://www.usereuben.com/about): background, skills and experience
- [Projects](https://www.usereuben.com/projects): plugin and frontend work
- [Services](https://www.usereuben.com/services): engagement models, process and fit
- [Start a project](https://www.usereuben.com/start-a-project): project brief form, replies within 48 hours

## Services

- **Plugin Build** (4–6 weeks): a custom WordPress or WooCommerce plugin designed around the client's workflow, secured by default and documented for handover.
- **Frontend Build** (6–10 weeks): designs turned into a production React, Vue.js or Next.js interface, with WCAG AA accessibility and a Lighthouse 90+ performance budget.
- **Integrate & Optimize** (2–4 weeks): performance and code audits, Core Web Vitals fixes, CRM and marketing API integrations, app-to-app automation.

Most engagements run 2 to 12 weeks, depending on scope.

## Projects

WordPress plugins:
- [Linksy](https://linksyai.com): AI internal linking plugin using keyword extraction and NLP
- [Linksy Search & Replace](https://linksyai.com): database utility to search and update URLs, anchors and titles across a site
- [Datey AI](https://plugli.com): content freshness manager that finds outdated years and terms in posts
- [AltTexty](https://plugli.com): AI bulk alt-text generator for image accessibility

Frontend:
- [Shortly](https://url-shortener-zeta-ebon.vercel.app/): URL shortener built in React on the Shrtcode API
- [Agile System](https://agile-system.vercel.app/): Kanban-style project management dashboard
- [Nestlify](https://nestlify-react-app.vercel.app/): SaaS marketing site
- [usereuben.com](https://www.usereuben.com/): this portfolio (React, Vite, GSAP, WebGL)
